Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have face-up security cards, gain 1 memory.

[Main] By suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card in your face-up security cards. If this effect digivolved, you may place 1 Digimon card with the [Royal Base] trait from your hand face up as the bottom security card.
